elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards"
"will conform in all material respects to its then-current documentation" — conformance is qualified by materiality
"for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery"
No services duration stated; only the 12-month software period appears
"refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface or related software"
"TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance"
"free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code"
"twelve (12) months following delivery" exceeds the 90-day floor
No services warranty duration is expressed anywhere in the inserted text
"re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund of the fees paid"

offending_extra_words: in all material respects to its then-current documentation and specifications
reasons: Preferred level fails: the services warranty has no express duration (preferred requires 90 days), and software conformance is qualified as "in all material respects" rather than express conformance to documentation.
Fallback is also incomplete on its own terms because no services warranty period (30 days) is stated; the levels cannot be mixed.

Minimality: added qualifiers ("consistent with industry standards", "in all material respects", "and specifications", vendor-elected remedy "at TrueLink's option") go beyond what is needed and dilute the position; the remedy election should not be at the Vendor's discretion under our preferred wording.

Fix: insert "and, for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform to their documentation" and delete "in all material respects" from the software conformance limb.
